name: OnPay
description_en:
OnPay is payroll software whose help center explains worker selection, hours and wage review, pay schedules and submission deadlines. The documented payroll service includes US tax filing, but that does not establish payroll support in every country.

A useful evaluation separates payroll processing from optional HR and Time Tracking subscriptions. Older pricing language about included features needs to be read alongside the September 2026 HR add-on documentation. Actual eligibility, funding lead time and purchased bundle require confirmation in the account.
description_zh:
OnPay 的帮助中心说明了员工选择、工时与工资审核、发薪计划及提交截止时间。文档介绍美国工资税申报服务，但不能据此推断支持所有国家的工资处理。

评估时应区分工资处理与可选 HR、Time Tracking 订阅。较早价格文档关于所含功能的说法，需要结合 2026 年 9 月的 HR 附加订阅说明阅读。实际资格、资金处理提前期和购买组合仍需在账户内确认。

core_features.explanation_en: Select workers, enter or import hours, review wages and check payment methods before processing.
core_features.explanation_zh: 选择员工、输入或导入工时，处理前审核工资和付款方式。

core_features.name_zh: 发薪计划与提交截止时间
core_features.explanation_en: Upcoming runs show pay periods, check dates and submit-by dates for each schedule.
core_features.explanation_zh: 待处理批次显示各计划的工资期间、发薪日期及提交截止时间。

core_features.explanation_en: Team Basics is included with Payroll Essentials; the broader HR dashboard and custom workflows are an add-on.
core_features.explanation_zh: Payroll Essentials 包含 Team Basics，范围更广的 HR 仪表板及自定义流程需附加订阅。

pricing.notes_en: May 2025 help article: $49 base + $6/person; current checkout, currency and newer add-on prices unverified.
pricing.notes_zh: 2025 年 5 月帮助文章：基础费 $49 加每人 $6；当前结账、币种及新附加服务费用未核实。

official_check.scope: Public primary sources read; no account, purchase, integration execution, performance benchmark, owner identity or publication approval tested.

review_notes: Original English synthesis and corresponding Chinese translation from the attached primary sources. Vendor documentation does not establish independent testing or customer outcomes.
Original directory feature labels were replaced with product-specific documented capabilities. Unknowns and unreviewed alternatives remain unknown.

sections.title_en: Prepare hours and inspect the run
sections.en: Select the workers for a run, enter hours and wages, and inspect overrides, supplemental pay and payment methods. Imported hours overwrite previously entered hours and wages, so import before final review. An override can persist across later runs until removed. A suitable trial scenario is a small group with one hourly worker and one salaried worker, comparing expected gross pay and deductions with the review screen; this is an editorial test proposal, not an executed pay run.
sections.zh: 先选择本批员工，录入工时与工资，再核对覆盖费率、附加报酬及付款方式。导入工时会覆盖已输入的工时和工资，应在最终审核前完成；覆盖费率可能持续用于后续批次，直到移除。可用一名时薪、一名固定薪资员工的小样本，将预期税前工资及扣款与审核页比较；这只是建议的试验场景，未实际发薪。

sections.title_en: Choose the schedule and meet its deadline
sections.title_zh: 选择计划并遵守截止时间
sections.en: A schedule’s frequency cannot be edited; create another schedule when the frequency changes. Upcoming runs show a submit-by date for ACH processing. Submitting late can delay direct deposit, and the help page describes holding deposits and issuing paper checks as an alternative workflow. Skipping an elapsed period means no wages are paid for that period; it is not evidence that wage obligations disappear. Changes in a worker profile do not automatically update an already opened pay period.
sections.zh: 计划频率不能直接编辑，改变频率需创建新计划。待处理批次显示 ACH 处理的提交截止日；迟交可能延迟直接存款，帮助页另说明暂停直接存款并开纸质支票的流程。跳过已过期期间意味着该期间不支付工资，不能据此认为工资义务消失。员工档案中的更改不会自动更新已打开的发薪期间。

sections.title_en: Understand the billing unit and dated rate
sections.title_zh: 理解计费单位与价格日期
sections.en: The May 1, 2025 pricing article lists $49 base plus $6 per person and unlimited pay runs. A person included in a run counts even with zero net pay; repeated inclusion within the same billing period counts once. A September 2025 billing FAQ explains billing on the first or fifteenth for the preceding usage period and possible sales tax. These are dated public help-page amounts, not a current checkout quote or a verified currency denomination. Subscription pages and any new bundle can differ.
sections.zh: 2025 年 5 月 1 日价格文章列出基础费 $49 加每人 $6，并说明发薪次数不限。员工只要被纳入批次，即使净工资为零也计费；同一计费期间重复纳入只计一次。2025 年 9 月账单 FAQ 说明在 1 日或 15 日就此前使用期间计费，可能另收销售税。这些是有日期的公开帮助页金额，不是当前结账报价，也未确认货币种类；账户订阅页及新组合可能不同。

sections.title_en: Keep add-ons separate from basic onboarding
sections.title_zh: 区分附加 HR 与基础入职功能
sections.en: The September 29, 2026 article includes offer-letter templates, W-4/I-9 file requests and basic audits in Team Basics. The HR add-on adds features such as a dedicated dashboard, directory, custom signature templates, document reviews and PTO approvals. Company > Billing > Subscription shows available HR and Time Tracking bundles. Do not interpret the older all-features pricing sentence as proof that these newer subscriptions are free.
sections.zh: 2026 年 9 月 29 日文章将录用通知模板、W-4/I-9 文件收集及基础审核列入 Team Basics；HR 附加订阅增加独立仪表板、目录、自定义签名模板、文件审阅及休假批准等功能。Company > Billing > Subscription 显示 HR 与 Time Tracking 组合；不能将旧价格页的“全部功能”表述当作这些新订阅免费的证明。

sections.en: Before operating payroll, confirm worker data, funding account, deposit approval and submission deadlines. The billing FAQ describes a bank-change form, test transactions and ACH-team confirmation before the replacement account can be used. Organizations needing a verified non-US payroll service or an independently validated compliance guarantee need separate evidence. No bank change, tax filing or payroll execution was tested.
sections.zh: 正式发薪前应确认员工资料、扣款账户、直接存款资格及截止日。账单 FAQ 说明换银行需要表格、测试交易及 ACH 团队确认，新账户不能直接视为已启用。需要已核实的美国以外工资服务或独立合规保证的组织，仍需另取证据；本轮未测试换银行、税务申报或发薪。

content_method.author: Codex (AI assistant)
content_method.method: Public primary-source research, original English editorial synthesis and Chinese translation. Hypothetical examples are not executed tests.

research_gaps.en: Current checkout and HR/Time Tracking bundle amounts are not verified; the public pricing article predates the HR add-on article.
research_gaps.zh: 当前结账及 HR/Time Tracking 组合价格未核实，公开价格文章早于 HR 附加订阅文章。

research_gaps.en: Payroll, banking, permission isolation, exports and jurisdiction-specific compliance were not executed or independently audited.
research_gaps.zh: 未实测发薪、银行操作、权限隔离、导出或特定辖区合规，也未独立审计。
